compute_box_areas: compute the area of bounding boxes in a BoxList using the area function
compute_pairwise_iou: compute pairwise intersection-over-union scores between two BoxLists using the iou function
compute_pairwise_ioa: compute pairwise intersection-over-area scores between two BoxLists using the ioa function
apply_non_max_suppression: apply non maximum suppression to a BoxList with configurable IOU and score thresholds
apply_multi_class_nms: apply multi-class non maximum suppression to a BoxList with per-class score thresholds
